title: client-boarding-lightning-standup-2026-05-09
content:
SE + ProServices weekly lightning standup notes — 2026-05-09

Attendees: Marcus Lee (host), Priya Nair, Sofia Alvarez, Ethan Park, Leah Wong, Tomás Rivera, Samir Gupta (SRE patch-in)

Goal: rapid sync on active onramps, call out immediate customer blockers, confirm owners and short deadlines. Keep to 25 minutes.

TOPLINE SUMMARY:
- Two customers (Pinecrest Financial, MercuryDocs) cleared staging smoke; schedule prod roll next week pending compliance sign-off.
- GrayMatter Labs throttling observed on model routing; SRE working a mitigation (circuit-breaker config) — temporary fallback to smaller variant enabled.
- Telemetry gaps: missing correlation_id on a subset of Dedicated requests (affects cost attribution).
- Action: capture a concise playbook for ‘noisy client’ patterns (owner: Priya, due 2026-05-13).

QUICK WINS / DECISIONS:
- Agreed to enable debug-level tracing in the Canary window for Pinecrest (48h window starting 2026-05-11). Owner: Ethan.
- Temporary increase in Dedicated pool for MercuryDocs approved for one billing week to avoid throttling during doc import. Owner: Leah.
- Stoplight for GrayMatter: GREEN -> AMBER. If circuit-breaker change not stable by end of day Thursday, escalate to infra oncall.

CUSTOMER UPDATES (concise):

1) Pinecrest Financial — onboarding sprint 3
Status: staging smoke passed (chat + embeddings). Security review awaiting final SOC2 evidence.
Blockers: legal requested encryption-at-rest artifact for S3 mirror (2FA keys). Security team needs KMS key policy snippet from Private deployment template.
Next steps: Priya to assemble KMS policy snippet + example command; legal review scheduled 2026-05-12. Prod roll tentative 2026-05-14 pending sign-off.
Notes: Pinecrest will use Dedicated with private networking; confirm IP allowlist copy with customer before roll.

2) MercuryDocs — large document ingestion & embeddings
Status: indexer working; memory pressure surfaced in 3rd batch run. Staging ingest throughput stable at 250 docs/min after batch-size tuning.
Blockers: transient OOM on dedicated node when processing extremely long PDFs (~120MB).
Next steps: Leah to request + provision a higher-memory node from infra for the import job; set autoscaling rule to spin an extra node for the import window. Targeted prod import: 2026-05-12 to 2026-05-14.
Notes: telemetry show spikes aligned with attachment parsing; file-size guardrail needs documentation in onboarding checklist.

3) GrayMatter Labs — latency variance on routed models
Status: customers report 95th pct latency spikes on long context windows. We enabled fallback to smaller model variant for critical paths.
Blockers: routing policy (smart-routing) misclassified a subset of requests as high-cost and routed to a slower tier. Likely cause: incorrect sequence_length heuristics.
Next steps: Samir (SRE) and Tomás to add an instrumented workload to reproduce distribution; target fix to heuristic by 2026-05-11. If not fixed, extend fallback and notify account team.
Notes: add synthetic test to CI that simulates 1000 requests with long context to catch regression. Owner for CI test: Tomás.

4) GrayMatter (separate request) — private deployment onboarding
Status: initial package delivered; customer needs air-gapped install instructions for their compliance team.
Blockers: current installer relies on github.com artifacts; need offline mirror + signed tarball.
Next steps: create 'airgap-install' artifact set and signed checksums. Owner: Sofia. ETA 2026-05-18.

INFRA / SRE NOTES:
- Observed missing correlation_id on ~4% of Dedicated requests (affects per-token billing attribution dashboard). Root cause: old clientlib (v0.8) used by internal integration harness.
Action: pin internal harness to clientlib v1.2 and re-run smoke suite. Owner: Ethan. ETA 2026-05-11.
- Circuit-breaker thresholds adjusted for low-priority queues; monitor for false positives. Samir to open INT-4187 for tracking metrics.

OPERATIONS & ROLLOUTS:
- Canary plan template updated (shorter canary, extra logging). PR merged: infra#1284. Confirmed with deployments team.
- Fallback policy: add customer notification step when fallback model is used >3x in a 1h window (customer-facing webhook). Product to craft language. Owner: Marcus + Product (Sally).

RISKS / ESCALATIONS:
- Risk: Pinecrest legal delay could push prod roll, exposing us to cost overrun on reserved capacity. Mitigation: Cap dedicated burst to 2 GPUs for week-of-roll.
- Risk: MercuryDocs import could surface more OOMs if large-file distribution heavier than expected. Mitigation: enforce 50MB soft limit and chunk files client-side. Work with customer on pre-scan.

OPEN ACTIONS (owners + due):
- Priya: KMS policy snippet for Pinecrest — due 2026-05-11
- Leah: Provision higher-memory node + autoscale rule for MercuryDocs import — due 2026-05-10
- Ethan: Pin internal harness to clientlib v1.2 + rerun smoke — due 2026-05-11
- Tomás: CI synthetic long-context test — due 2026-05-15
- Samir: INT-4187 metrics and dashboard tile for circuit-breaker events — due 2026-05-12
- Sofia: airgap artifact + signed tarballs — due 2026-05-18
- Marcus/Product: fallback-notify webhook spec + copy for customers — due 2026-05-13

PARKING LOT / NOTES TO SELF:
- Need a short checklist for 'large-attachment ingestion' to add to onboarding docs (quick wins: file-size guardrail, chunking, parse timeout).
- Consider patching clientlib to auto-inject correlation_id for older clients — discuss next week with SDK team.
- Revisit Dedicated burst pricing communication — Dwight in finance asked for a one-pager; add to next-week agenda.

MEETING FEEDBACK / FORMAT TWEAKS:
- Keep future syncs strictly 25 minutes — start with blockers only. If a customer deep-dive needed, spin a follow-up with relevant folks.
- Prefer actionable owners with due-dates in this doc.

NEXT SYNC: 2026-05-16 09:00 PT (regular weekly slot)

End of notes.

Unresolved questions to raise in next triage:
- Who owns the 'airgap installer' ongoing maintenance? (platform vs proservices?)
- Quick decision: allow temporary Dedicated burst billing to be charged to onboarding pool or to customer? (finance input required)
